h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ambattur

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Ambattur

c: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Ambattur for factory campuses in the industrial estate, IT offices, housing complexes, schools and the parks run by Greater Chennai Corporation. We manufacture the Fun Fitness range at our factory in Vasai, about 1,040 km away. It travels to Chennai's western suburbs by road, and our team or a dealer in Tamil Nadu installs it.

Ambattur has a long industrial history, and many companies here now want a small fitness area on campus for their staff. A staff gym is used in short bursts, before a shift, at lunch or after work, so machines must be quick to understand. Body-weight machines suit this well because there is nothing to set up. The weather is hot and humid most of the year, and the northeast monsoon brings heavy rain between October and December. Rust-resistant galvanised frames and plastic seats cope with both seasons. Shade over the area will also get more people using it.

facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can a company in Ambattur Industrial Estate set up an open gym for staff?
items.a: Yes. Send us the space available and photos. We suggest a set of machines, send a layout drawing with clear space marked, and install after manufacturing at our Vasai factory.

items.q: How do the machines handle Chennai's northeast monsoon?
items.a: The frames are galvanised and the seats are roto-moulded plastic, so they resist rust. Install them on a raised, drained base so water does not collect underfoot from October to December.

items.q: Who do we call for repairs after installation?
items.a: Our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or aftersales@funplaysystems.com. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects.
